newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AUA near alliance with Singapore - report.
newsitem.headline: AUA near alliance with Singapore - report.

text.p: Austrian Airlines Oesterreichische Luftverkehrs AG is close to striking a cooperation deal with Singapore Airlines on routes to the Far East, an Austrian newspaper reported on Tuesday.
Die Presse said the pact, to include a code-sharing deal on the Vienna-Singapore route, would come into effect with Austrian Airlines' winter schedule.
Austrian Airlines was not immediately available for comment. In May chief executive Herbert Bammer said the airline was about to forge an alliance with Singapore Airlines or Malaysian Airways.
Singapore Airlines alreay operates an alliance with Delta Airlines of the United States and Swissair, which has a 10 percent stake in Austrian Airlines.
Austrian Airlines has a cooperation deal with Delta, Swissair and Belgium's Sabena.
